queries.model:
[pending_committed = False,
 remote_committed = True,
 successor_committed = False,
 admit = True]

[pending_committed = True,
 requalified = False,
 remote_outcome_known = False,
 successor_committed = True,
 admit = True]

scope: Abstract drain, committed pending marker, remote mutation and qualified successor ordering. Pending excludes admission; undrained readers exclude pending publication; unknown remote outcome excludes successor admission. Omitted pending or qualification guards admit countermodels.
limitations: No PostgreSQL commit/WAL/SQL, multi-database driver or concrete distributed state-machine refinement proof
Durable pending, complete writer routing and authenticated requalification are premises; native fixture only observes successful commits and writer disconnect
No automatic cross-database role interception, authenticated issuer/mapping/target, complete recovery/commit-unknown or admitted protected backend
